subject: crowbar
label: crowbar, in the place of the game's models/v_crowbar.mdl, models/p_crowbar.mdl, models/w_crowbar.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_shotgun.mdl, models/w_9mmar.mdl, models/w_sqknest.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked C, B, D, A where the asset was D, B, C, B: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: The brief asks for a crowbar, which is a bent bar with a hooked claw at one end. In sides.png the asset is a straight, flat slab with no hook or fork at either end (FRONT, LEFT, RIGHT, TOP views). The overall bar shape is there, but the defining claw is missing, so the outline is not a crowbar's.

M2.reason: Measured length is 32.4 against the brief's 32, a 1.3% difference, well within 15%. The brief gives no width or height, so none is checked against it.

M3.reason: Parts the brief asks for, listed: hooked claw at the head (missing entirely in every view), a round or tapered shaft (the asset is a square-section slab, 32.4 x 2 x 10.5), a grip (absent), red paint (absent, see M4), bare-metal worn tips (only faint light bevels at the two ends, not clearly worn metal). The claw and the grip are not there in shape or paint, so this is 0.

M4.reason: The brief asks for a red-painted steel crowbar. The asset is uniformly grey in every view (sides.png, first-person.png, in-hand.png), with no red anywhere. The colour is wrong across the whole model, not only in one region.

M5.reason: The wear the brief asks for is partly hinted: the two ends carry lighter bevelled edges that read a little like worn metal, and a diagonal streak runs along the face (sides.png TOP and FRONT-LEFT). But there is no red paint for the wear to show through, so the 'worn to bare metal at the tips' detail is only half there.

M6.reason: Scored at the cap of 2 as the rubric sets, from the line-up measure: in four readings of lineup.png the judges picked the asset as the odd one out once (its D reading), and passed it as Valve's in the other three. The visual mismatch (a grey slab, no claw, no red) is charged to M1, M3 and M4 rather than to M6.

M7.reason: There is no hooked head to fix the front, so the front cannot be checked against the original. The model sits upright as a flat bar in the views, and it stands on its origin without floating. Front and placing are only partly checkable, so this is 1.

M8.reason: The measured checkErrors list is empty, so it passes SMAK's GoldSrc check. Triangles are 10, far below twice the median for props of its size. The box is closed in every view: no open face, nothing inside out, nothing floating.

W1.reason: In first-person.png the asset sits at the centre-left, tilted and large, while the game's own crowbar sits at the lower right, held by its shaft. So the asset is in a different place, angle and way round from the original. No hand is drawn in any view, so it is not shown leaving the hands. In attack.png the slab swings out of frame, which by the rubric is not leaving the hands. Placement is clearly off, not proven broken.
